sourceText:
Lemon Loaf Cake
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 24, 2009 - 11:13pm

Ingredients




1 1/2 cups All-purpose flour
1 1/4 teaspoons Baking powder
3/4 teaspoon Ground ginger
1/4 teaspoon Salt
1 cup Granulated sugar
Rind (colored part only) of 2 lemons
6 ounces Unsalted butter, softened
3 ounces Cream cheese, softened
2 lrg Eggs
8 ounces Lemon yogurt
1/2 cup Confectioner's sugar
5 teaspoons Fresh lemon juice

Preparation

1 1. Heat oven to 325 degrees. Grease an 8 1/2-by 4 1/2-inch loaf pan and dust lightly with flour. Sift together flour, baking powder, ginger and salt; set aside. 2 2. Sprinkle several tablespoons of granulated sugar on a cutting board. Add lemon rind and chop as fine as possible. Transfer to a large mixer bowl and add remaining granulated sugar, butter and cream cheese. Beat on high speed until light and fluffy, 3 minutes. Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each addition. Add yogurt and mix well. Stop the mixer and add dry ingredients. Mix just until combined. 3 3. Transfer batter to prepared pan. Bake until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean, 60 to 70 minutes. Cool in pan for 5 minutes then invert onto a wire rack. 4 4. Make glaze by mixing confectioner's sugar and enough lemon juice to make a glaze. Pour over warm cake.
